input.rationale: Correcting the wording of the behavior entry that records the outsider-entries phase. The measurement shows the entry present in the node's log and the node's applied index advancing, and the library's own AppliedIndex documentation distinguishes dispatching an entry to the FSM over the apply channel from the application consuming it, so the entry must not claim FSM consumption. The event fields are unchanged and the same receipt and event index are cited.

knowledge.statement: A node whose configuration is empty after a RestoreCommittedLogs restart stores a command entry delivered by a server that appears in no configuration and dispatches it toward the FSM: the AppendEntries succeeded, the entry appeared in the node's log (last index advanced), and the node's applied index, which the library documents as the index sent to the FSM rather than the index the application has consumed, advanced over it.
knowledge.conditions: RestoreCommittedLogs=true with a commit-tracking store; no snapshot, so the recovered configuration is empty; the sender is transport-reachable and its request carries one command entry with a leader commit index covering it.
knowledge.changed_premise: The previous revision said the node 'stores and applies' the entry and spoke of a single applied command; the measurement supports storage plus dispatch toward the FSM (applied index 6 to 8), and the library's AppliedIndex documentation states that this index does not mean the application has consumed the entry, so the claim is narrowed to what was measured.

knowledge.statement: With RestoreCommittedLogs enabled, NewRaft's configuration scan starts at max(lastSnapshotIndex, lastApplied)+1 after restoreFromCommittedLogs has set lastApplied to the recovered commit index; committed LogConfiguration entries at or below that index are therefore never passed to processConfigurationLogEntry, so r.configurations keeps the snapshot configuration or stays empty when no snapshot exists.
knowledge.conditions: Config.RestoreCommittedLogs=true with a LogStore implementing CommitTrackingLogStore; the node restarts from its retained log, stable store and snapshots; the configuration entry index is at or below the commit index reported by GetCommitIndex.

knowledge.statement: processLogs feeds r.fsmMutateCh in batches of MaxAppendEntries, while runFSM (its only consumer) is started only after restoreSnapshot/restoreFromCommittedLogs inside NewRaft; a recovered committed range needing more batches than the 128-slot buffer leaves NewRaft blocked in that batch send, and the blocked goroutine is visible as processLogs.func1 under restoreFromCommittedLogs under NewRaft.
knowledge.conditions: Config.RestoreCommittedLogs=true with a commit-tracking store whose recovered commit index spans more than 128 batches of authored entries, and no consumer started yet inside NewRaft.

history.statement: processLogs feeds r.fsmMutateCh in batches of MaxAppendEntries, while runFSM (its only consumer) is only started after restoreSnapshot/restoreFromCommittedLogs; a recovered committed range needing more batches than the 128-slot buffer makes NewRaft block in the send.
history.conditions: Config.RestoreCommittedLogs=true, a commit-tracking store whose recovered commit index spans more than 128 batches of authored entries, and no consumer started yet inside NewRaft.

knowledge.statement: A node whose configuration is empty after a RestoreCommittedLogs restart still answers RequestVote and RequestPreVote with Granted=true for a candidate that appears in no configuration, because both handlers apply their membership rejection only when the candidate's own Servers list is non-empty; the node also adopts the requester's higher term and derives a quorum size of 1 from the empty voter list.
knowledge.conditions: RestoreCommittedLogs=true with a commit-tracking store; the node restarts with no snapshot so its configuration is empty after NewRaft; the requester's term is higher and its last log entry is at least as recent as the node's; the request is delivered over the transport.

knowledge.statement: The public configuration future reports index 0 and Stats reports latest_configuration_index "0" regardless of the committed configuration entry's index, because the future is built with only the latest configuration set and its latestIndex stays at the zero value.
knowledge.conditions: Any node state; measured after a committed LogConfiguration entry with the live configuration already containing the changed server set.

knowledge.statement: A node that leads with a configuration recovered from its snapshot while the configuration in force has more voters computes its commitment quorum from the recovered set: it acknowledged a client entry that only two of the five voters held, and a leader elected afterwards from the configuration in force (five voters, quorum three) did not hold that entry.
knowledge.conditions: RestoreCommittedLogs=true with a commit-tracking store; the node restarts from a snapshot recording a three-voter configuration while the configuration in force is five voters and the recommitting entry is in its log but outside the restart scan; leadership of that node is then established and a client write is applied to it.

knowledge.statement: A server that is no longer part of the configuration can still make a voter campaign and displace the serving leader by sending a TimeoutNow request: the handler stores the transfer trigger without inspecting the sender, and the resulting campaign carries the leadership-transfer flag that suppresses voters' rejection for nodes that already know a leader.
knowledge.conditions: A configuration from which the sending server has been removed while it remains transport-reachable; the request is sent over the transport to a surviving voter; the receiving voters know a healthy leader.

knowledge.statement: A node whose configuration is empty after a RestoreCommittedLogs restart stores and applies a command entry delivered by a server that appears in no configuration: the AppendEntries succeeded, the entry appeared in the node's log and the node's applied index advanced over it.
knowledge.conditions: RestoreCommittedLogs=true with a commit-tracking store; no snapshot, so the recovered configuration is empty; the sender is transport-reachable and its request carries one command entry with a leader commit index covering it.

result.summary: Corrected the behavior entry for the outsider-entries phase so it states what was measured: the empty-configuration node stored the non-member's entry and its applied index advanced over it, with the library's own AppliedIndex documentation cited to distinguish dispatch toward the FSM from the application having consumed it; the statement was narrowed accordingly and the same receipt and event index remain cited. No new execution or comparison was claimed; the four-receipt account for that child question is unchanged.
